turns.line: Hi Leo. How is your numbers project going?
Quite well, actually. I've been measuring things around school, and I'm starting to see some interesting patterns.
Patterns? Tell me more. What have you found so far?
Well, the average student spends about an hour on homework every night, which is more than I expected.
Really? And roughly what percentage of students said that?
Around sixty percent. The amount of time surprised me too, especially on weekends.
So the sum of all that homework time must be quite high. Did you calculate it?
Yes, I did. I also checked the probability of rain this weekend, since we're planning a school trip.
Good thinking. Did you measure the classrooms as well?
Yes. The length of our classroom comes to nine meters, while the width is just seven.
About three meters, although I had to estimate it from the door frame.
What about the weight of the sports equipment?
The football weighs around four hundred grams, though I'd like to check the shot put too.
Great. Have you organized all your numbers?
Yes. I put them in a sequence, from smallest to largest, so the data is easier to compare.
Excellent work, Leo. Your data is complete, and I'm genuinely impressed with your project.
